title: Hard mismatch: immediate move-in and 4 bedrooms
buyer_primary_need: A four-bedroom home available for move-in next month.
key_information_learned: The buyer needs to move in next month.
Both requirements are firm, and the buyer says Pearlmont will not work.

transcript.message: I need to move in next month and need four bedrooms. Any unit?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.message: Based on the current Phase 1 information, Pearlmont won’t meet those requirements: the units are 900 sq. ft. with 3 bedrooms and 2 bathrooms, and expected completion is Q4 2029, so they won’t be ready to move into next month. transcript.speaker: agent
